record_title: Finite Grothendieck quotients control object-cotorsion completeness
provenance: A finite-Grothendieck-quotient extension of the Ren--Wang parity construction, with exact quotient-valued criteria for special object approximations and arbitrary finite abelian defect groups.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Ren--Wang's parity example and its Ext/ideal-cotorsion mechanism, the foundational ideal-approximation theory, and Thomason--Matsui Grothendieck-group classifications of dense subcategories are prior art. The claims here are the finite-quotient extension, the exact two obstruction maps, the full G x G defect spectrum, and realization of every finite abelian defect group. The proof assumes a Hom-finite semisimple category with finitely many simple objects and a finite-index subgroup. The full 2013 foundational article was not independently inspected. No independent validation is asserted.
